# Fabric items built by hand (not generated by the converter)

`PL_Spark_Test` ran two Synapse Spark notebooks. ADF cannot run Synapse notebooks, so in the ADF source they
were replaced with `Wait` placeholders, and the converter turns those into Waits in Fabric too. Fabric *can*
run notebooks, so the original logic was rebuilt there directly. These files are the copy kept in Git.

Fabric workspace: **adf-migration-test** (`53d67e72-8124-4ca3-ae55-c4b266935faa`).

| Fabric item | Type | File here | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LH_Migration` | Lakehouse | – | Has the OneLake shortcut `Files/migrationcontainer` → ADLS `datamigrationadftofabric` / `migrationcontainer` (through the `Sathvik-ADF` connection). |
| `NB_Read_Raw_Data` | Notebook | [notebooks/NB_Read_Raw_Data.py](notebooks/NB_Read_Raw_Data.py) | Creates the sample data (4 customers, 5 sales) as CSV and Parquet. |
| `NB_Transform_Cab_Data` | Notebook | [notebooks/NB_Transform_Cab_Data.py](notebooks/NB_Transform_Cab_Data.py) | Joins sales with customers and totals `Amount` by `City` and `Product`. |
| `PL_Spark_Test` | Data pipeline | [pipelines/PL_Spark_Test.pipeline-content.json](pipelines/PL_Spark_Test.pipeline-content.json) | Runs the two notebooks in order (the Synapse order). |

All output goes under `migrationcontainer/migration-test/spark-test/`, so the Copy pipelines' files in
`migration-test/csv` and `migration-test/parquet` are never overwritten.

**Do not redeploy `PL_Spark_Test` from the tool.** Its ADF source still has the `Wait` placeholders, so a redeploy
would replace the notebook activities with Waits again. The other ten pipelines can be redeployed as usual.

To restore an item, create it in Fabric from these files (Fabric REST API `updateDefinition`, or paste the code into
a notebook attached to `LH_Migration`). The notebook paths use the workspace and Lakehouse IDs above; change them if
the Lakehouse is recreated.
